title: LowBit: RISC-V-First Platform for Branch-Prediction and Cache-Behavior Characterization
note: A RISC-V-first benchmark ecosystem for branch-prediction and cache-behavior characterization. The planned taxonomy combines controlled branch and cache patterns into 500 small, deterministic C programs, providing a reproducible basis for architectural characterization.

title: OS Synchronization as Symmetry Restrictions in Sn
note: Formalization of synchronization as symmetry restrictions in Sn is complete, along with defining and refining a metric on the space for geometric analysis. Pending work includes interpreting the metric structure and tuning model hyperparameters.
